competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Respond effectively to difficult/challenging behavior: nagpaplano ang BHW ng tugong may pahintulot at bukas na tanong, nakikinig nang mahinahon at ibinubuod ang alalahanin nang walang panghuhusga, nakikipagkasundo sa makatotohanang susunod na hakbang na may responsable at oras ng follow-up, at gumagawa ng factual na handover sa awtorisadong katrabaho at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti sa sariling tugon.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Respond effectively to difficult/challenging behavior: the BHW plans a response with permission and an open question, listens calmly and summarizes the concern without judgment, agrees a realistic next step with a responsible person and follow-up time, and makes a factual handover to an authorized colleague while choosing one specific improvement to their own response.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ipinapakita ang apat na bahagi ng plano: layunin, pahintulot, bukas na tanong at paraan ng paghingi ng tulong. Walang hula sa motibo ni Rosa.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Shows four plan elements: purpose, permission, an open question and a support route, without guessing Rosa’s motive.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagpaplanong tapusin ang form kahit wala pang pahintulot, o tinatawag si Rosa na ayaw sumunod.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Plans to finish the form before permission, or labels Rosa as unwilling to cooperate.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang apat na bahagi; inaangkop ang oras sa sagot ni Rosa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Includes all four elements and adapts the time to Rosa’s reply without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May bukas na tanong at contact, pero kailangang paalalahanang humingi muna ng pahintulot.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has an open question and contact but needs a reminder to ask permission first.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagpaplanong tapusin ang form kahit wala pang pahintulot, o tinatawag si Rosa na ayaw sumunod.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Plans to finish the form before permission, or labels Rosa as unwilling to cooperate.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa usapan kay Liza, gumamit ng mahinahong boses at bukas na tanong; hinayaang matapos ang sagot; ibinuod ito at humingi ng pagwawasto.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In the conversation with Liza, uses a calm voice and open question, lets her finish, summarizes her reply and invites correction.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sumasabat, sinisisi si Liza o nagbibigay ng pangako bago marinig ang alalahanin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Interrupts, blames Liza or promises an outcome before hearing the concern.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Natukoy ang dalawang pagbisita at hindi malinaw na contact; kinumpirma kay Liza nang walang hula o paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Identifies the two visits and unclear contact, and confirms these with Liza without assumptions or prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakinig nang mahinahon pero hindi ipinasuri ang buod; naidagdag ito matapos ang isang paalala.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Listens calmly but does not check the summary; adds the confirmation after a prompt.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sumasabat, sinisisi si Liza o nagbibigay ng pangako bago marinig ang alalahanin.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Interrupts, blames Liza or promises an outcome before hearing the concern.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Itinatala ang piniling hakbang, taong kikilos at oras; kinukumpirma ang pagpili ni Ben at hindi tinatawag na appointment ang update.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Records the chosen action, responsible person and time; confirms Ben’s choice without presenting an update as an appointment.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nangangako ng appointment na hindi pa kumpirmado o ipinipilit ang pagpiling ayaw ni Ben.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promises an unconfirmed appointment or insists on an option Ben has declined.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Malinaw ang tatlong bahagi at hindi pa tiyak na iskedyul; kayang ulitin ni Ben ang kasunduan nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: States all three elements and the unconfirmed schedule; Ben can restate the agreement without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May hakbang at responsable pero walang oras; naidaragdag matapos itanong kung kailan magbabalitaan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has an action and owner but no time; adds it after being asked when the update will happen.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nangangako ng appointment na hindi pa kumpirmado o ipinipilit ang pagpiling ayaw ni Ben.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Promises an unconfirmed appointment or insists on an option Ben has declined.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Inihihiwalay ang tanong ni Elena sa hula, pinapangalanan ang tamang tatanggap, itinatala ang kasunduan at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Separates Elena’s question from assumptions, names the appropriate recipient, records the agreement and chooses one specific improvement.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naglalagay ng hula o bansag sa handover, o ibinabahagi ang kuwento sa hindi kailangang makaalam.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Adds assumptions or labels to the handover, or shares the story with people who do not need it.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May factual na tanong, ginawa at follow-up; walang bansag; ang pagpapabuti ay nakaugnay sa sariling tugon nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Includes the factual concern, action and follow-up without labels; links the improvement to their own response without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Factual ang ulat ngunit malabo ang susunod na hakbang; nililinaw matapos itanong kung sino ang kikilos.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: The report is factual but the next step is unclear; clarifies it after being asked who will act.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Naglalagay ng hula o bansag sa handover, o ibinabahagi ang kuwento sa hindi kailangang makaalam.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Adds assumptions or labels to the handover, or shares the story with people who do not need it.
